newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: UPCOMING SHARE SUSPENSIONS ON BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: UPCOMING SHARE SUSPENSIONS ON BOURSE.

text.p: Lithuania's bourse said in a statement on Monday that its board had agreed to suspend trade in the following shares:
- Ukmerges Biofabrikas, from May 26 to May 30, at issuers' request because of its general shareholders' meeting.
- Lithuanian Energy, from May 27 until June 15, because of reorganisation of the company.
- Liteksas Calw, from May 27 for three trading sessions because of the assimilation of its share issues.
- Sanitas, from May 27 for three trading sessions, because of the assimilation of its share issues.
- Vilniaus Bank, from May 27 for three trading sessions, because of the assimilation of its share issues after its privileged shares had been converted into ordinary shares.
- Rokishkis Cheese, from May 29 until June 6, at issuers' request, because of the general shareholders' meeting.
